```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(CloneCensorWeight)
```

## Study data

The package expects a `CloneCensorWeightData` object with OMOP-derived cohort,
outcome, and covariate tables. This vignette uses the reproducible fixture;
the same object contract is returned by `getDbCloneCensorWeightData()` after
database extraction.

```{r data}
ccwData <- createSampleCloneCensorWeightData(n = 200, seed = 2026)
```

## Trial strategies

Subjects are cloned into two strategies: initiate treatment within 30 days or
do not initiate during the grace period. A clone is artificially censored at
the first protocol deviation.

```{r cloning}
arms <- list(
  list(arm = "initiate", strategy = "initiate"),
  list(arm = "never", strategy = "never")
)
cloned <- createClonesAndCensor(
  cloneCensorWeightData = ccwData,
  arms = arms,
  gracePeriod = 30,
  washoutPeriod = 0
)
dplyr::collect(cloned$cohorts) |> head()
```

## Censoring weights and outcome model

```{r analysis}
personTime <- discretizePersonTime(cloned, intervalLength = 30)
weighted <- createCensoringWeights(personTime, cloned)
weightSummary <- computeWeightDistribution(weighted)
outcomeModel <- fitOutcomeModel(weighted, modelType = "cox")
weightSummary
outcomeModel$summary
```

The outcome model is fitted through Cyclops. Diagnostics are ordinary small R
objects and can be plotted or saved independently of the disk-backed analysis
tables.

```{r diagnostics, eval=FALSE}
plotWeightDistribution(weighted)
plotKaplanMeier(weighted)
plotCovariateBalance(computeCovariateBalance(cloned, weighted))
```
